decisions.reason: Builds on existing logistics and customer service processes, so the firm can assimilate and improve it.
Though faster delivery requires some new logistics coordination, it remains close to existing delivery operations and can be learned.
Directly extends the firm's core steel fire-resistant door knowledge and is already European-approved, so absorptive capacity is very high.
Leverages existing distribution channels for doors and gates, making it closely related and easy to interpret and improve.
Requires digital and software capabilities far from the firm's metal fabrication knowledge, limiting its ability to assimilate and improve the platform.
Builds directly on existing fire and smoke protection door expertise, so the firm can effectively learn from early results and keep improving it.
